newsitem.title: USA: Snap-on says higher dealer sales boosted Q3.
newsitem.headline: Snap-on says higher dealer sales boosted Q3.

text.p: Snap-on Inc said third-quarter results benefited from higher U.S. dealer-van sales, acquisitions and strong sales growth in the company's European segment.

"The quarter's performance also reflects continuing improvements in operating efficiencies, as expenses as a percent of net sales declined to 40.7 percent from 41.8 percent a year ago, the company said.

The company said third quarter net sales were $347.2 million, compared with $309.1 million in the third quarter of 1995. Net earnings for the quarter increased to $30.8 million, versus $26.3 million in the same period a year ago. Per share earnings were $0.51, compared with $0.43 a year ago.
Shares in the hand and power tools maker and distributor were unchanged at 33-3/8.
